one_line: Sultan of Bengal, son of Raja Ganesha, ruling from Pandua during the formative years of Bengali Sultanate architecture.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, medium height, wiry but dignified build
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, warm medium-brown Bengali complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, thoughtful sharp eyes with slightly arched brows, default expression calm and resolute with a hint of introspection.
appearance.hair: straight dark brown hair, medium length to just below ears, mostly hidden under a deep indigo turban wrapped low and firm around the head with a small folded tail at the back, a narrow white cloth band peeking at the base as an under-wrap.
appearance.costume: A long-sleeved, knee-length quilted jama of rich deep maroon cotton, overlapping and tied to the right with fabric ties, subtly patterned with small diamond stitching; over it a sleeveless dark green silk waistcoat (farji-style) with simple gold piping along the edges; loose beige cotton churidar-style trousers gathered at the ankles; a broad woven sash of muted terracotta orange wrapped around the waist and knotted at the left hip, ends hanging; soft brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes; around the neck a simple gold chain and at the wrists plain gold bangles; he wears a short dark indigo cloak draped from the shoulders to mid-thigh, open in front, its border embroidered with a repeating terracotta and gold geometric motif echoing brick-and-terracotta patterns of Pandua.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved single-edged Indo-Persian style sword with a modest steel blade and a plain brass hilt, carried in a simple dark brown leather scabbard with minimal brass fittings, worn at his left hip through the terracotta sash.

ref_desc: Jalaluddin Muhammad Shah has an oval medium-brown face, short beard, dark indigo turban, deep maroon quilted jama, dark green waistcoat, terracotta sash, beige churidar trousers, brown mojari shoes, and a plain brass-hilted curved sword at his left hip in a dark scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Jalaluddin Muhammad Shah standing in a neutral pose: an oval-faced Bengali man in his mid-30s with a medium-brown complexion, high cheekbones, thoughtful sharp eyes, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, and calm resolute expression. His straight dark brown hair is mostly hidden beneath a deep indigo turban wrapped low and firm with a small folded tail at the back and a narrow white under-band at the base. He wears a long-sleeved, knee-length deep maroon quilted jama overlapping to the right, its surface subtly patterned with small diamond stitching, over which sits a sleeveless dark green silk waistcoat with simple gold piping along the edges. Around his waist is a broad woven sash in muted terracotta orange, wrapped and knotted at his left hip with the ends hanging. His trousers are loose beige cotton churidar-style, gathered at the ankles, and his feet are in soft brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes. Over his shoulders is a short dark indigo cloak that hangs to mid-thigh, open at the front, its border embroidered with a repeating terracotta and gold geometric motif reminiscent of brick-and-terracotta building decoration. He has a simple gold chain at his neck and plain gold bangles at his wrists. At his left hip, threaded through the terracotta sash, is his signature weapon: a slightly curved single-edged steel sword with a plain brass hilt, in a dark brown leather scabbard with minimal brass fittings. Use deep maroon, dark indigo, dark green, terracotta orange, beige, and warm metallic copper-gold tones as the dominant colours.
